boundedRawOracleProbe.aql:
LET candidates = (
  FOR s IN Specimen
    FILTER s.project == @project AND s.dataset_generation == @generation
    SORT s._key
    LIMIT 2000
    RETURN { key: s._key, id: s._id }
)
LET bySpecimen = (
  FOR candidate IN candidates
    LET specimen = DOCUMENT(candidate.id)
    FILTER specimen != null
      AND specimen.project == @project
      AND specimen.dataset_generation == @generation
    LET patients = (
      FOR edge IN fhir_edge
        FILTER edge._from == specimen._id
          AND edge.label == 'subject_Patient'
          AND edge.project == @project
          AND edge.dataset_generation == @generation
          AND STARTS_WITH(edge._to, 'Patient/')
        LET patient = DOCUMENT(edge._to)
        FILTER patient != null
          AND patient.project == @project
          AND patient.dataset_generation == @generation
        RETURN DISTINCT {
          id: patient.payload.id,
          _id: patient._id,
          gender: patient.payload.gender,
          genderOwnProperty: HAS(patient.payload, 'gender'),
          genderIsNull: IS_NULL(patient.payload.gender),
          genderValue: (HAS(patient.payload, 'gender') ? patient.payload.gender : null),
          resourceType: patient.payload.resourceType
        }
    )
    RETURN {
      anyDirectPatient: LENGTH(patients) > 0,
      exactlyOneDirectPatient: LENGTH(patients) == 1,
      onePatientWithValidID: LENGTH(patients) == 1 AND IS_STRING(patients[0].id) AND LENGTH(patients[0].id) > 0,
      onePatientGenderMissing: LENGTH(patients) == 1 AND patients[0].genderOwnProperty == false,
      onePatientGenderNull: LENGTH(patients) == 1 AND patients[0].genderOwnProperty == true AND patients[0].genderIsNull == true,
      onePatientGenderNonemptyString: LENGTH(patients) == 1 AND patients[0].genderOwnProperty == true AND IS_STRING(patients[0].genderValue) AND LENGTH(patients[0].genderValue) > 0,
      onePatientGenderOther: LENGTH(patients) == 1 AND NOT (patients[0].genderOwnProperty == false OR patients[0].genderIsNull == true OR (IS_STRING(patients[0].genderValue) AND LENGTH(patients[0].genderValue) > 0))
    }
)
RETURN {
  project: @project,
  generation: @generation,
  candidateLimit: 2000,
  candidateCount: LENGTH(candidates),
  candidatesWithAnyDirectPatient: LENGTH(FOR row IN bySpecimen FILTER row.anyDirectPatient RETURN 1),
  candidatesWithExactlyOneDirectPatient: LENGTH(FOR row IN bySpecimen FILTER row.exactlyOneDirectPatient RETURN 1),
  candidatesWithOneValidPatientID: LENGTH(FOR row IN bySpecimen FILTER row.onePatientWithValidID RETURN 1),
  candidatesWithOnePatientGenderMissing: LENGTH(FOR row IN bySpecimen FILTER row.onePatientGenderMissing RETURN 1),
  candidatesWithOnePatientGenderNull: LENGTH(FOR row IN bySpecimen FILTER row.onePatientGenderNull RETURN 1),
  candidatesWithOnePatientNonemptyStringGender: LENGTH(FOR row IN bySpecimen FILTER row.onePatientGenderNonemptyString RETURN 1),
  candidatesWithOnePatientOtherGender: LENGTH(FOR row IN bySpecimen FILTER row.onePatientGenderOther RETURN 1)
}
boundedRawOracleProbe.interpretation: Every candidate in the bounded slice has exactly one valid scoped subject_Patient target, but each Patient.payload omits gender. The gender-all case therefore has no matching raw witness in this bound. This is not global absence and not a Builder failure.

scopeNote: The raw probe is bounded to the first 2,000 Specimens in one exact project and generation, sorted by _key. It establishes only that this slice contains no populated Patient.gender witness. It does not establish absence elsewhere in the generation. The browser bracket terminated before UI behavior and is retained as an unverified fixture/witness result, not a product failure. The probe applies no auth_resource_path constraint and does not establish restricted-auth behavior; the explicit root database credential is separate from application authorization.
